title: Front End Engineer (Sanity)
description:
Join Our Client as a Front End Engineer (Sanity)

About the Organisation


Our Client operates within the digital technology space, delivering innovative solutions that shape the future of online experiences. Renowned for their collaborative culture and commitment to growth, they foster a dynamic environment where creativity and technical excellence thrive. Recognised for leading-edge projects and a supportive community, it's an excellent place to develop your career and make a meaningful impact.
Role Overview
 Due to an exciting expansion driven by strategic initiatives, our Client is seeking a talented Front End Engineer with expertise in SanityCMS. This role is key to enhancing their digital presence and delivering seamless user experiences. It offers a unique chance to embed yourself in innovative projects that influence global digital platforms. If you are passionate about modern front-end development and eager to push boundaries, this opportunity is perfect for you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain responsive, accessible web interfaces using React and TypeScript, aligning with best practices.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to translate design concepts into functional web components.
  • Integrate and optimise SanityCMS to ensure content management is efficient and user-friendly.
  • Write clean, maintainable code in HTML, CSS, and TS, ensuring optimal performance across browsers and devices.
  • Participate in code reviews, troubleshooting, and refining performance to uphold high-quality standards.
  • Contribute to continual improvement of development processes and technical documentation.


Essential Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience building front-end applications with React and TypeScript.
  • Strong knowledge of HTML5/CSS3 for crafting responsive and accessible layouts.
  • Hands-on experience with SanityCMS or similar headless CMS solutions.
  • Familiarity with version control systems, particularly Git.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively within a team and follow clear technical guidance.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail and quality.


Desirable Skills & Experience

  • Additional experience with other JavaScript frameworks or libraries.
  • Knowledge of build tools and package managers like Webpack, npm, or Yarn.
  • Understanding of SEO best practices and performance optimisation techniques.
  • Experience with agile development methodologies.
  • Knowledge of UI/UX principles and graphic design tools.


Ready to Make an Impact?


If you are excited by the prospect of developing cutting-edge digital experiences and meet the essential criteria, we encourage you to submit your CV today. Join our Client's journey to innovate and shape the future of online content delivery.

title: Tech Lead .NET
description:
Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Atribuições:

- Definir e propor soluções técnicas alinhadas aos desafios do negócio, liderando o desenho da arquitetura com foco em performance, segurança e escalabilidade.

- Organizar e acompanhar as atividades do time de desenvolvimento, promovendo alinhamento técnico e fluidez na entrega de valor.

- Supervisionar a implementação das soluções, assegurando aderência aos padrões de qualidade, boas práticas de engenharia e governança de código.

- Promover o uso de boas práticas como testes automatizados, code review, integração continua, documentação técnica e segurança desde o desenvolvimento.

- Atuar com mentoria técnica, contribuindo para o crescimento da equipe por meio de orientação, feedbacks e compartilhamento de conhecimento.

- Ser o elo técnico entre o time de desenvolvimento e áreas parceiras como Produto, Segurança, Infraestrutura e demais squads.


Habilidades Técnicas:

- .NET Core / C# – domínio da linguagem e do framework para construção de APIs e aplicações backend.

- Mensageria – conhecimento prático em RabbitMQ e Apache Kakfa .

- Cache e performance – uso de Redis para otimização de consultas e redução de latência.

- Bancos de dados relacionais – domínio em SQL Server , incluindo modelagem, tunning de queries e boas práticas de banco de dados.

- Experiência prévia como Tech Lead ou referência técnica em squads ágeis.

- Vivência em ambientes com esteiras de CI/CD , testes automatizados e pipelines de deploy.

- Experiência com times que atuam no ecossistema de meios de pagamento .

- Boa comunicação , com habilidade para traduzir temas técnicos complexos em linguagem acessível para áreas não técnicas.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Wellhub - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: SAP Integration Lead (Inglês Avançado)
description:
SAP Integration Lead

We are looking for a consultant able to lead integration processes accross all levels of our client's environment, in contact with stakeholders and also with outside partners.

Together with the leading skills and understanding of the business, the ideal profile would have a strong technical background in SAP SD; SAP ABAP; SAP Order-to-Cash and EDI & Idoc Integration.


Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Provide solution architect leadership & strategy development.
  • Lead Technical architect for medium to large projects.
  • Accountable across multiple functional and technical areas with wide range of complexity.
  • Lead the overall design, including the structure of a segment solution based on requirements from the business, global and regional views, as well as the design of standard software configurations.
  • Building delivery blueprints including but not limited to application diagrams, physical architecture, process diagrams, systems maps, service interfaces, technical interfaces, data modeling, integration planning.
  • Translates non-functional and functional requirement into solution designs, ensuring solution aligns with business goals and processes, uses and provides enterprise information consistently, integrates effectively with other applications, supports a common application environment and user interaction model, uses the common technology platform, and achieves enterprise level security, quality of service and scale.
  • Collaborates with Enterprise Architecture to make sure that the solution fits within enterprise context, while also ensures solutions align with business goals and processes, and follow client's IT Standards and Best Practices.
  • Participates in client's Community of Practice forum with other Solution Architects.
  • Coordinates complex solution architecture implementations while leading design variances based upon business needs. Ensures artifacts are documented.
  • Coordinates engagements with internal and external parties as they relate to evaluation, design and delivery of business capabilities.
  • Contributes to the evaluation and selection of software product standards.
  • Participant in industry representation, policy formation, User Groups, and strategic direction.
  • Provides coaching and leadership to system software developers through enhancements and projects.
  • Works well with varying levels of Business and IT Professionals.
  • Able to communicate technical information in a non-technical manner to Business team (written and verbal).
  • Able to understand business requirements to turn into technical specification solutions.
  • Stay abreast of latest technologies in his/her functional space, consistently growing in knowledge and industry trends.

Candidate Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • 10 years IT professional work experience.
  • Mandatory to have excellent fluency in English; both written and verbal communication skills.
  • Candidate will be regarded as SME and should have high level of expertise in SAP - SD component.
  • Strong ABAP skills, with complex troubleshooting experience.
  • SAP Order-to-Cash end to end expertise required (SD).
  • EDI and Idoc experience highly preferred.
  • Experience in software engineering, software development, solution architecture and able to develop a High Level Design (HLD) and ideally with ability to deliver Low Level Designs within area of expertise.
  • Experience in highly integrated complex data environments e.g. EDI/ BI/ ETL, ERP etc, and open to working in a multitude of SAP and NonSAP applications and technologies.
  • Candidate should possess high level of consultative skills and have prior experience of collaborating with Business Analysts and Enterprise Architects in solving complex business problems with innovative technical solutions.
  • Strong leadership skills
  • Creative thinking
  • Self-motivated and self-starting on work
  • Strong Technical leadership of Application Development teams and vendors.
  • Experience collaborating with Enterprise Architects and infrastructure engineers to identify, design, and implement highly complex, end-to-end solutions.
  • Strong understanding of SDLC processes and methodologies
  • Excellent collaboration skills and can quickly cultivate networking opportunities within the organization at varying levels of Business and IT Professionals.
  • Broad range of business and IT experiences
  • Hold technical and/or business certification(s).
  • Ability to work in a virtual team across distance, with different cultures and time zones, in a matrix with multiple reporting lines, with on-shore and off-shore resources (may extend outside the organization including suppliers, partners and customers).


We are digital changemakers – here to disrupt old ideas, blaze new trails, and help enterprises transform and scale at unparalleled speed.

title: SAP Cloud Architect - SAP Basis
description:
About HCLTech
HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.
To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit you an experienced SAP Basis Consultant ready to take the next step in your career? Join our Cloud Architect Advisory (CAA) team as a SAP Cloud Architect, where you'll guide customers through their SAP RISE journey and shape the future of enterprise landscapes.
About the Role
As a SAP Cloud Architect, you’ll be the strategic advisor for customers transitioning to the SAP RISE platform. This customer-facing role involves planning, designing, and presenting SAP landscape architectures tailored to each client’s needs and hyperscaler preferences (AWS, Azure, GCP). You’ll collaborate closely with SAP Sales and Account Executives to ensure technical accuracy and optimal design.
Note: This is a purely architectural role—no hands-on implementation required. What You’ll Gain
Exposure to cutting-edge SAP technologies: S/4HANA, HANA DB, MDG, Ariba, Salesforce, and more.Access to SAP’s internal training and learning resources.Experience across multiple industries and customer landscapes.A unique opportunity to work on diverse architecture setups not typically available in standard SAP Basis roles.

This customer-facing role involves planning, designing, and presenting SAP landscape architectures tailored to each client’s needs and hyperscaler preferences (AWS, Azure, GCP). You’ll collaborate closely with SAP Sales and Account Executives to ensure technical accuracy and optimal design.
Note: This is a purely architectural role—no hands-on implementation required. What You’ll Gain
Exposure to cutting-edge SAP technologies: S/4HANA, HANA DB, MDG, Ariba, Salesforce, and more.Access to SAP’s internal training and learning resources.Experience across multiple industries and customer landscapes.A unique opportunity to work on diverse architecture setups not typically available in standard SAP Basis roles.

title: Copywriter Sênior
description:
Você será o/a responsável por criar um departamento do absoluto zero, focado exclusivamente em reduzir o CPL do Pobre, enquanto atrai usuários cada vez mais qualificados para a audiência usando o tráfego pago. Buscamos um perfil sênior. Alguém pronto, intuitivo, experiente e estratégico.


Responsabilidades:

  • Você deve ser capaz de desenvolver processos ultra-simplificados, criar e liderar ideias, orientar o time de conteúdo e, acima de tudo, não se limitar à execução de demandas, mas sim o responsável por uma direção estratégica própria.
  • Na maior parte do tempo, o seu trabalho será de criação. Você terá à disposição um influenciador 100% focado na marca, dedicado integralmente às produções e disponível para gravações, testes, validações de conteúdo, roteiros, ideias e novos formatos.
  • Você também poderá guiar atores, UGCs, influenciadores e colaboradores na produção de conteúdos estratégicos voltados ao Pobre.
  • Conforme as demandas crescerem ou surgirem necessidades estratégicas, o seu time será ampliado. Você terá autonomia para indicar novos profissionais, desde que atendam aos padrões da marca.
  • É parte do seu trabalho não apenas reduzir o custo de expansão da audiência, mas conseguir qualificar leads das mais diferentes classes sociais, tornando a comunicação mais ativa, consistente e valiosa.
  • É seu dever manter uma comunicação clara, direta e respeitosa, contribuindo com insights estratégicos para capacitar não apenas o seu departamento, mas também o time de produto.


Requisitos:

  • O grande desafio deste processo seletivo é entender se você realmente sabe qual é o direcionamento criativo adequado para a marca do Pobre. Buscamos alguém que já compreenda todas as implicações decorrentes do nome e do tom característico da marca. Alguém que não precisa de explicações óbvias para captar a essência do Pobre e transformá-la em conteúdo de alto impacto.
  • Se você olha para uma marca chamada “Promoções para Pobres” e o seu lado creator não borbulha, este é um importante sinal de que aqui talvez não seja lugar para você.
  • Você precisa compreender que o Pobre jamais será uma marca tradicional. Você terá um grande desafio criativo, precisará estar sempre atualizado. Ser veloz, flexível e saber navegar por tendências é essencial.
  • Se você não se considera cronicamente online, não faz ideia do que é um shitpost, jamais foi heavy user de Twitter/X e é desconectado desses mundos, essa vaga provavelmente não é para você.
  • Organização, autogestão e compromisso com prazos e entregas são inegociáveis. Esperamos maturidade e responsabilidade profissional.
  • Aqui é um lugar de paz. Desenvolver e liderar as equipes, deve ser um processo natural, sempre se comunicando de maneira eficiente, humana e respeitosa.
  • Você precisa entender técnicas avançadas de copywriting, gatilhos mentais e storytelling.
  • Portfólio, formação superior ou domínio de língua estrangeira (especialmente inglês) são bem-vindos, mas não são critérios eliminatórios.


Da Remuneração e Contratação:

  • Modelo de contratação PJ.
  • Salário a combinar, compatível com a senioridade e o aumento de responsabilidade do cargo.
  • Metas, incentivos e bônus de performance podem ser combinados.
  • A vaga não exige a criação e otimização de anúncios.

title: Analista de rede
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!


Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Administração de redes Wi-Fi : configuração e suporte em controladoras Cisco (WLC 25XX, 35XX, 55XX, 98XX); criação e manutenção de SSIDs com autenticação MAC, 802.1X, Portal Guest (ISE), e APs em modo Local/Flexconnect.

Segurança da informação : sustentação de firewalls Palo Alto, Cisco ASA (FTD-Standalone) e Firepower + FMC; criação e revisão de regras, URL Filtering, Application Control, gestão de VPNs (Client-to-Site – Global Protect) e ambientes em HA.

Infraestrutura LAN : configuração de switches Cisco (29XX, 92XX, 95XX), VLANs, interfaces trunk/acesso e políticas de port-security.

Conectividade WAN : operação e monitoração de ambientes SD-WAN (Aruba SilverPeak), aplicando conceitos de alta disponibilidade e otimização de tráfego.

Monitoramento proativo : administração da ferramenta SolarWinds (nodes, alertas, tuning de monitoramento).

Relacionamento com vendors : abertura e gestão de chamados junto a TAC Cisco e Palo Alto, acompanhamento de incidentes críticos e processos de RMA.

Documentação e melhoria contínua : elaboração de procedimentos técnicos, relatórios de incidentes e recomendações de boas práticas.



Requisitos e qualificações

Formação superior completa em Engenharia de Computação, Redes, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas ;

Experiência prática em suporte e sustentação de redes corporativas de grande porte ;

Domínio em Cisco Wireless (WLC) e Switching Cisco (29XX, 92XX, 95XX) ;

Experiência sólida em Firewall Palo Alto e Cisco Firepower/ASA ;

Conhecimento em VPNs, URL Filtering, HA e Application Policies ;

Vivência com ferramentas de monitoramento SolarWinds ;

Imprescindível Inglês avançado.


Atuação Remota em escala 12x36 das 07 às 19h


Informações adicionais

O que te oferecemos:


Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Auxílio Creche;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência Médica;

description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack Sênior - Python/React
description:
Sobre a Empresa

A vaga é para uma empresa recém adquirida pelo iFood, eles possuem uma plataforma tecnológica voltada ao setor de food service, que digitaliza e automatiza toda a operação de restaurantes. Oferece módulos como cardápio digital, gestão de pedidos, delivery e relatórios analíticos. A solução é integrada, funciona mesmo offline e atende desde pequenos negócios até grandes redes.



Sobre o Papel

Como Desenvolvedor FullStack Sênior - Python e React, você será responsável por:


Responsabilidades

  • Participar ativamente do desenvolvimento de aplicações web de ponta utilizando as tecnologias Python e React;
  • Trabalhar em todas as etapas do ciclo de desenvolvimento, desde a concepção da aplicação até a sua implantação;
  • Colaborar com a equipe de Produto e Design para traduzir requisitos em soluções técnicas eficientes;
  • Escrever código de alta qualidade, bem documentado e testado;
  • Identificar e implementar melhorias constantes nos processos e na arquitetura da aplicação;
  • Compartilhar conhecimento e dar suporte técnico à equipe, sempre buscando o crescimento coletivo.



Habilidades Necessárias

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Python e suas principais bibliotecas (Django, Flask, etc.);
  • Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento de aplicações web com React.js;
  • Familiaridade com banco de dados relacionais (SQL) e não relacionais (NoSQL);
  • Habilidade em desenvolver APIs RESTful e trabalhar com arquiteturas orientadas a microserviços;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de versionamento de código (Git) e metodologias ágeis;
  • Bom entendimento de conceitos de infraestrutura e implantação de aplicações (containerização, CI/CD, etc.);
  • Comunicação eficaz, proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.


Contratação CLT com benefícios padrões de mercado.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Role: Operations Manager (Salon, Spa, and Aesthetic industry - MUST HAVE EXPERIENCE)

Role Specifics: We are only considering candidates with experience in the Salon, Spa, and Aesthetic industry. Please apply only if you have worked in this field.

Contract: Full-time Remote Contractor (40 hours weekly / 160 hours monthly)

Business Hours: Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM EST

Rate: $12.50 - $18 USD hourly / $2,000 - $2,880 monthly (salary is negotiable based on experience and location)

Availability to Start: Immediately


Client's Profile

Founded in New Jersey in 1997, this award-winning luxury salon and wellness spa is more than a destination for beauty; it's a space for transformation, self-expression, and connection. With multiple locations and a commitment to continuous growth, they've cultivated a brand rooted in intentional service, elevated aesthetics, and deep care for their clients and team. Grounded in a culture of excellence and evolution, the company is led by a visionary founder who blends business with purpose, creating a salon experience that is as soul-filled as it is stylish. Their dedication to excellence has earned them national recognition, including features in major media outlets and accolades from platforms such as CBS and The Knot.


What You'll Do

As the Operations Manager, this role is not a traditional operations assistant role, and it's not suited for a traditional candidate. The client is building more than a business. They are nurturing a vision of trust, growth, and collaborative improvement. As the Operations Manager, you are the trusted partner who supports the founder from behind the scenes, with clear systems, executive presence, and emotional intelligence. You don't need to be perfect. But you do need to care deeply. This role blends organizational operations, systems management, and strategic support. You'll facilitate team meetings, track KPIs, manage tools like Zenoti and Shopify, coordinate marketing tasks, and keep the founder's priorities aligned. This hands-on role is ideal for someone who thrives in structure, demonstrates initiative, and prioritizes clarity and detail. Your responsibilities will include:


Operations & Integrator Coordination: 60% Role Allocation

Team & Operations Management

  • Be the primary support to the Founder in managing day-to-day operations and overall team integration.
  • Be the point of contact for internal issues and help with swift resolution.
  • Help create and implement organizational strategies that support company goals.
  • Lead planning sessions, team meetings, and 1:1s; take notes and follow up on action items.
  • Manage projects from start to finish, including timelines, budgets, and delivery.
  • Track team KPIs and tasks, offering support where needed.
  • Prepare reports on Operations and Team Performance for the Founder.
  • Identify ways to improve processes and communication, applying emotional intelligence in communication dynamics.
  • Create and maintain an easy-to-follow Operations Playbook.


System Management & Process Oversight

  • Manage internal tools like Zenoti and Qnity, including employee logs, credentials, client scheduling, cancellations, promo campaigns, etc.
  • Oversee inventory and updates in Zenoti and Shopify, ensuring stock is correct and within budget.
  • Review reports and workflows to find and fix inefficiencies.


Marketing & Content Coordination: 25% Role Allocation

Marketing Coordination

  • Coordinate marketing tasks across departments to keep campaigns on track.
  • Oversee the submission and organization of marketing materials, advertisements, and promotions within Zenoti and Shopify.


Content Curation & Social Media Management

  • Support social media efforts by duplicating and scheduling content (IG, FB, LinkedIn, Google) to align with business initiatives.
  • Write simple copy, quotes, or weekly updates as needed, ensuring consistent brand tone.
  • Monitor engagement and share relevant content ideas as needed.


Strategic Founder & Client Support: 10% Role Allocation

  • Own the Founder's calendar, meetings, and priorities; give daily updates.
  • Keep the Founder's email inbox organized, respond to messages, and track follow-ups.
  • Turn the Founder's ideas (notes or voice memos) into actionable tasks.
  • Protect the Founder's time while supporting the team and aligning priorities.
  • Communicate with clients as needed, handling urgent escalations, urgent follow-ups and building relationships.


What You Should Have

Must-haves:

  • At least seven years of experience in Executive Support, Operations, or Integrator roles, ideally supporting C-level or Founder Executives.
  • Experience supporting a Founder or Executive in a Salon, Spa, Aesthetic, or Wellness brand, particularly in fast-paced, multi-business environments.
  • At least one year of experience in a global remote or virtual environment for a company or with clients in North America, Europe, Australia, or the UAE.
  • Strong integrator and operational management skills, with the ability to translate high-level strategies into actionable plans and workflows.
  • Mastery of English communication skills, both written and verbal, with a professional tone and neutral accent for both internal coordination and client correspondence.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, coordinate with cross-functional teams, and manage day-to-day operations.
  • Client-facing experience, with the ability to handle escalations professionally and maintain relationships.
  • Hands-on experience with Zenoti (or similar scheduling/inventory systems) and Shopify for backend coordination and updates.
  • Experience in light copywriting, editing, and scheduling social media content across IG, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Google platforms.
  • Proficient in remote office tools like Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Calendar) and Slack (or Teams).
  • Experience with project management tools like Asana, Notion, or ClickUp.
  • Proven experience supporting internal operations, maintaining trackers and summary reports (e.g., logins, performance, promos).
  • Exposure to process optimization frameworks, with the ability to implement improvements and create SOPs from scratch.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative without close supervision, and keep executives focused on what matters most.


Technology Specifications:

  • Minimum 100 Mbps Internet Speed
  • Windows 11 or MacOS 15 Sequoia
  • Minimum Intel i5 8th gen with 8GB RAM or Apple M1 chip with 8GB RAM
  • Webcam and Headset
  • Designated Quiet Office Space


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS) framework, including L10 meetings, Rocks, Scorecards, and IDS.
  • Basic design knowledge for editing branded visual assets in Canva.


Who You Are

We are hoping you are someone who:

  • Naturally steps in to solve problems, keep things moving, and stays a few steps ahead.
  • Thinks clearly and critically, great at untangling complex challenges, spotting what's not working, and helping build smoother systems.
  • Communicates with clarity and confidence, whether giving a quick update to the team or coordinating with external partners, you know how to get the message across with emotional intelligence.
  • Keeps everything (and everyone) on track, juggles timelines, priorities, and moving pieces with calm precision and care for the brand image.

Client's Profile

Founded in New Jersey in 1997, this award-winning luxury salon and wellness spa is more than a destination for beauty; it's a space for transformation, self-expression, and connection. With multiple locations and a commitment to continuous growth, they've cultivated a brand rooted in intentional service, elevated aesthetics, and deep care for their clients and team. Grounded in a culture of excellence and evolution, the company is led by a visionary founder who blends business with purpose, creating a salon experience that is as soul-filled as it is stylish. Their dedication to excellence has earned them national recognition, including features in major media outlets and accolades from platforms such as CBS and The Knot.


What You'll Do

As the Operations Manager, this role is not a traditional operations assistant role, and it's not suited for a traditional candidate. The client is building more than a business. They are nurturing a vision of trust, growth, and collaborative improvement. As the Operations Manager, you are the trusted partner who supports the founder from behind the scenes, with clear systems, executive presence, and emotional intelligence. You don't need to be perfect. But you do need to care deeply. This role blends organizational operations, systems management, and strategic support. You'll facilitate team meetings, track KPIs, manage tools like Zenoti and Shopify, coordinate marketing tasks, and keep the founder's priorities aligned. This hands-on role is ideal for someone who thrives in structure, demonstrates initiative, and prioritizes clarity and detail. Your responsibilities will include:


Operations & Integrator Coordination: 60% Role Allocation

Team & Operations Management

  • Be the primary support to the Founder in managing day-to-day operations and overall team integration.
  • Be the point of contact for internal issues and help with swift resolution.
  • Help create and implement organizational strategies that support company goals.
  • Lead planning sessions, team meetings, and 1:1s; take notes and follow up on action items.
  • Manage projects from start to finish, including timelines, budgets, and delivery.
  • Track team KPIs and tasks, offering support where needed.
  • Prepare reports on Operations and Team Performance for the Founder.
  • Identify ways to improve processes and communication, applying emotional intelligence in communication dynamics.
  • Create and maintain an easy-to-follow Operations Playbook.


System Management & Process Oversight

  • Manage internal tools like Zenoti and Qnity, including employee logs, credentials, client scheduling, cancellations, promo campaigns, etc.
  • Oversee inventory and updates in Zenoti and Shopify, ensuring stock is correct and within budget.
  • Review reports and workflows to find and fix inefficiencies.


Marketing & Content Coordination: 25% Role Allocation

Marketing Coordination

  • Coordinate marketing tasks across departments to keep campaigns on track.
  • Oversee the submission and organization of marketing materials, advertisements, and promotions within Zenoti and Shopify.


Content Curation & Social Media Management

  • Support social media efforts by duplicating and scheduling content (IG, FB, LinkedIn, Google) to align with business initiatives.
  • Write simple copy, quotes, or weekly updates as needed, ensuring consistent brand tone.
  • Monitor engagement and share relevant content ideas as needed.


Strategic Founder & Client Support: 10% Role Allocation

  • Own the Founder's calendar, meetings, and priorities; give daily updates.
  • Keep the Founder's email inbox organized, respond to messages, and track follow-ups.
  • Turn the Founder's ideas (notes or voice memos) into actionable tasks.
  • Protect the Founder's time while supporting the team and aligning priorities.
  • Communicate with clients as needed, handling urgent escalations, urgent follow-ups and building relationships.


What You Should Have

Must-haves:

  • At least seven years of experience in Executive Support, Operations, or Integrator roles, ideally supporting C-level or Founder Executives.
  • Experience supporting a Founder or Executive in a Salon, Spa, Aesthetic, or Wellness brand, particularly in fast-paced, multi-business environments.
  • At least one year of experience in a global remote or virtual environment for a company or with clients in North America, Europe, Australia, or the UAE.
  • Strong integrator and operational management skills, with the ability to translate high-level strategies into actionable plans and workflows.
  • Mastery of English communication skills, both written and verbal, with a professional tone and neutral accent for both internal coordination and client correspondence.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, coordinate with cross-functional teams, and manage day-to-day operations.
  • Client-facing experience, with the ability to handle escalations professionally and maintain relationships.
  • Hands-on experience with Zenoti (or similar scheduling/inventory systems) and Shopify for backend coordination and updates.
  • Experience in light copywriting, editing, and scheduling social media content across IG, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Google platforms.
  • Proficient in remote office tools like Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Calendar) and Slack (or Teams).
  • Experience with project management tools like Asana, Notion, or ClickUp.
  • Proven experience supporting internal operations, maintaining trackers and summary reports (e.g., logins, performance, promos).
  • Exposure to process optimization frameworks, with the ability to implement improvements and create SOPs from scratch.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative without close supervision, and keep executives focused on what matters most.


Technology Specifications:

  • Minimum 100 Mbps Internet Speed
  • Windows 11 or MacOS 15 Sequoia
  • Minimum Intel i5 8th gen with 8GB RAM or Apple M1 chip with 8GB RAM
  • Webcam and Headset
  • Designated Quiet Office Space


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS) framework, including L10 meetings, Rocks, Scorecards, and IDS.
  • Basic design knowledge for editing branded visual assets in Canva.


Who You Are

We are hoping you are someone who:

  • Naturally steps in to solve problems, keep things moving, and stays a few steps ahead.
  • Thinks clearly and critically, great at untangling complex challenges, spotting what's not working, and helping build smoother systems.
  • Communicates with clarity and confidence, whether giving a quick update to the team or coordinating with external partners, you know how to get the message across with emotional intelligence.
  • Keeps everything (and everyone) on track, juggles timelines, priorities, and moving pieces with calm precision and care for the brand image.

title: Automation Anywhere Senior RPA Developer
description:
Practia is present in 7 countries, leading automation and digital transformation projects for major clients. We are one of the most prestigious business and technology companies in Latin America, with a specialized methodology and technical team in automation and Hyperautomation.


We have partnerships and certifications with leading market platforms, acting as a Diamond Partner with UiPath, Platinum Partner with Automation Anywhere, Gold Partner with Microsoft, and Silver Partner with IBM. Our experience and expertise in automation services have earned us, among various awards, the USN (UiPath Service Network) badge and UiPath's LATAM Partner of the Year award.

We are looking for a Senior RPA Developer with expertise in the Automation Anywhere 360 platform to support us in a strategic project alongside a team of analysts and developers.

This person will be involved in the entire RPA development cycle, starting from reviewing the functional documentation, defining development complexity, providing support for solution design and architecture, developing the automation, and supporting testing phases, automation deploy in production and hypercare.

They will be trained in our exclusive development framework and Hyperautomation methodology, SmartBPA®, which spans from Discovery to COE implementation.

As a key contributor to the Intelligent Automation Program , you will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business analysts, solution architects, and IT professionals, to automate complex business processes while ensuring high-quality, maintainable, and secure automation solutions.


What are we looking for?

  • A person with seniority, experience and expertise in automation development.
  • A person with a consultative and collaborative approach.
  • A person who enjoys working in an environment that fosters competence, transparency, and trust.


Roles and Responsibilities:


  • Degree in Technology, Engineering, or Administration.
  • Experience in automation development with Automation Anywhere platform (Minimum of 5 years).
  • Automation Anywhere 360 Advanced and Master certifications.
  • Design, develop, deploy and sustain end-to-end automation solutions using Automation Anywhere A360.
  • Build and maintain reusable bot components
  • Integrate GenAI/ML, IDP, and APIs into automation workflows for enhanced functionality.
  • Work closely with the Solution Architect to ensure best practices, security, and compliance in automation solutions.


Job Requirements

  • Hands-on experience integrating RPA solutions with APIs, databases, and enterprise applications.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, VBScript or JavaScript.
  • Experience in design, develop and debug complex automation workflows and implement robust error-handling mechanisms.
  • Experience in integrating GenAI, ML and IDP into intelligent automation solutions
  • Queue management.
  • Development of standardized documentation (PDD and SDD).
  • Use of frameworks.
  • Experience with Agile methodology, mainly using Scrum and Kanban.
  • Fluent in English.


Knowledge that may be a differential for the position:

  • Knowledge of cloud platforms services like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
  • Knowledge of Automation Anywhere IA Agents, IA Studio, Enterprise Knowledge and Document Automation products.
  • Other certifications and trainings in the intelligent automation field.

description:
Na Jaya Tech , acreditamos na Engenharia de Software Consciente , uma abordagem inovadora, e por isso oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho inspirador, focado em promover o autoconhecimento, tomar decisões embasadas em dados, cultivar relacionamentos saudáveis e entender o impacto do nosso trabalho. title: Full Stack Mobile Developer (Flutter, C#/.NET)
description:
Company Description

US based health technology company to be disclosed during the interview process.


Role Description

We are seeking a Full Stack Mobile Developer  to join our team and take ownership of our health monitoring mobile application. This application integrates with a Bluetooth-enabled ring pulse oximeter to collect health data throughout the night. 


The ideal candidate will be a hands-on developer with expertise in both mobile development (Flutter/Dart) and backend technologies (C#/.NET), capable of ensuring seamless device integration, reliable overnight data collection, and robust backend connectivity with Azure services. 


Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and maintenance of cross-platform mobile flagship application using Flutter/Dart for iOS and Android. 
  • Optimize Bluetooth connectivity with the ring pulse oximeter device. 
  • Address mobile battery optimization challenges to guarantee reliable overnight data collection. 
  • Introduce in app features to provide payments, notifications, and support (chat)
  • Manage the release process for both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. 
  • Collaborate with backend developers on Azure-hosted .NET services, contributing to backend development when required. 
  • Ensure compliance with health data security and privacy standards. 
  • Work independently while providing technical leadership within the team. 


Qualifications

  • Advanced English communication skills (C1 level), both written and spoken.
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, with strong expertise in mobile development. 
  • Proven experience with Flutter/Dart  for cross-platform mobile applications. 
  • Working knowledge of C# and .NET , with the ability to contribute to backend services. 
  • Deep understanding of Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE)  implementation. 
  • Experience with mobile battery optimization techniques  for background processes. 
  • Successful track record of publishing and maintaining apps in the App Store and Google Play. 
  • Experience integrating with Microsoft Azure services . 
  • Familiarity with Firebase  (Authentication, Crashlytics, Analytics), Sentry , and PostHog . 
  • Familiarity with in-app payment systems (such as Authorize.net, Stripe)
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail. 
  • Prior experience in health or medical app development is a plus.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
About the Role

Our client is loong for a highly skilled Full Stack Engineer to join a global product-focused technology team responsible for building large-scale web platforms used by millions of users. This role offers the opportunity to work in a collaborative, engineering-driven environment with strong ownership, modern cloud architectures, and end-to-end autonomy.


What You Will Do

  • Design and build responsive, web-based applications and learning tools used at scale.
  • Work closely with engineering, product, design, sales, and marketing teams to deliver impactful user-centric features.
  • Own the full software development lifecycle: architecture, development, testing, deployment, observability, and maintenance.
  • Implement Infrastructure-as-Code and monitoring best practices to ensure highly reliable applications.
  • Collaborate with a high-performing engineering group built around autonomy and extreme ownership.


What You Bring

Mandatory Skills

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with Java , ideally with Spring or Spring Boot.
  • Experience with Angular (preferred) or React.
  • Strong understanding of RESTful services , microservices, and distributed systems.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines , automated testing, and DevOps-oriented workflows.
  • Knowledge of databases (SQL or NoSQL).
  • Experience with AWS services for cloud-native application development.
  • Understanding of Docker and containerization concepts.
  • Experience with observability tools to monitor application health.
  • Solid understanding of backend engineering, with some experience across the full stack (front-end + backend).


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Terraform (highly desirable).
  • Experience developing B2B or B2C product engineering solutions at scale.
  • Experience building accessible, high-performance, responsive web applications .
  • Knowledge of distributed caching solutions (e.g., Redis).
  • Experience deploying applications on Tomcat or similar application servers.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field.

#VemSerVericoder

Desenvolvimento Front-end:

  • Criar interfaces de usuário atraentes e responsivas utilizando Angular e JavaScript.

  • Projetar e implementar APIs robustas e escaláveis utilizando frameworks e linguagens apropriados (C#, Python, Node.js, PHP e Laravel).

  • Gerenciar autenticação e autorização para garantir a segurança dos dados e das funcionalidades.

title: Direct Response Video Editor for 8-Figure DTC Brand
description:
Direct Response Video Editor (Remote - Brazil Preferred)


$1,200-$1,400 USD/month + $250+ Monthly Performance Bonuses


We're an 8-figure DTC beauty & wellness brand generating $1M+ in monthly revenue through high-volume, high-converting video advertising. We need an elite video editor who understands direct response mechanics and can produce scroll-stopping ads at scale.


Your work will directly drive sales across Meta, YouTube, and emerging platforms—with immediate feedback from millions of impressions monthly.


What You'll Actually Do


High-Volume Ad Production (40-60 ads/month): Transform raw creator footage, UGC clips, and b-roll into persuasive short-form ads (15-90 seconds) and VSLs that convert cold traffic into buyers. You'll work across multiple products and funnels simultaneously.


Master Direct Response Mechanics:

  • Craft hooks that stop thumbs in the first 3 seconds (pattern interrupts, bold claims, visual glitches)
  • Deploy engagement disruptors: kinetic typography, callout graphics, progress bars, emoji reactions
  • Optimize pacing for platform algorithms (Meta 9:16, YouTube Shorts)
  • A/B test visual approaches based on performance data


Post-Production Excellence Color grading, sound design, motion graphics, and seamless transitions using Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve. Your edits should feel polished but authentic—not overproduced.


Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.


AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.


Top Fits Will Have:

  • Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement)
  • 2+ years editing for DTC/eCommerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners)
  • Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve + After Effects
  • Deep understanding of Meta/YouTube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns
  • Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content
  • Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality
  • Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box)


Bonus Points:

  • Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes)
  • Motion design skills (After Effects, Cinema 4D)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles
  • Familiarity with CapCut, Descript, or AI editing tools
  • Portuguese + English fluency


Non-Negotiables:

  • Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions)
  • Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment
  • Obsessive attention to detail
  • Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedback



Why Top Editors Choose Us:


Transparent Compensation Base salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base.


Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within.


See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't).

title: Game Compliance e Development Consultant
description:
SOBRE A NÓS:

A DigiPlus Interactive Corp., líder em entretenimento digital nas Filipinas, chegou ao Brasil! Iniciamos nossas operações no Brasil em 2025 com o lançamento oficial da DigiPlus Brasil Interactive Ltda., e já estamos 100% licenciados para oferecer experiências inovadoras no mercado de iGaming.

Estamos trazendo o sucesso de plataformas renomadas como a BingoPlus para criar novas oportunidades e experiências incríveis para os brasileiros.


SOBRE A ATUAÇÃO DE CONSULTORIA:

Contrato PJ temporário (3 meses) podendo ser extendido, necessário inglês avançado para atuação global.


Irá fornecer consultoria especializada para garantir que os jogos proprietários da DigiPlus (bingo, jogos instantâneos e jogos esportivos) estejam em total conformidade com as regulamentações de jogos brasileiras e tecnicamente prontos para certificação por laboratórios acreditados (GLI, BMM, eCOGRA, etc.). Atuará na intermediação entre a interpretação da regulamentação, a validação matemática e a localização para o Brasil, possibilitando uma rápida implementação comercial.


ENTREGÁVEIS ESPERADOS DA CONSULTORIA:

Alinhamento com Regulamentações e Certificações

  • Auditar jogos proprietários existentes para verificar a conformidade com as Portarias 722, 1207 e regulamentações brasileiras correlatas.
  • Desenvolver e entregar um Relatório de Avaliação de Conformidade, resumindo as lacunas e as adaptações necessárias.
  • Elaborar ou revisar a documentação técnica para submissão aos laboratórios de certificação (regras, metodologia de RNG, tabelas de RTP, lógica de pagamento).
  • Recomendar melhorias no fluxo de trabalho para agilizar a preparação para a certificação e minimizar retrabalho.


Matemática e Validação de Jogos

  • Revisar e validar os modelos matemáticos do jogo: RTP, volatilidade, curvas de pagamento e lógica de probabilidade.
  • Executar ou supervisionar simulações e testes A/B para verificar os resultados matemáticos esperados.
  • Produzir um Resumo de Validação Matemática, identificando inconsistências, riscos e ajustes recomendados.


Localização e Adaptação ao Mercado

  • Avaliar os recursos do jogo quanto à adequação cultural e comportamental ao mercado brasileiro (visuais, UX, ritmo e terminologia).
  • Fornecer um Documento de Diretrizes de Localização que descreva os ajustes necessários para melhorar o engajamento do usuário e a conformidade.
  • Aconselhar sobre ajustes nas estruturas de prêmios, equilíbrio de dificuldade e preços para padrões de jogadores locais.


Suporte Interfuncional

  • Atuar como consultor regulatório e técnico para as equipes de produto, design e conformidade.
  • Traduzir os requisitos técnicos de conformidade em tarefas de desenvolvimento acionáveis.
  • Participar de reuniões de revisão quinzenais e fornecer feedback por escrito sobre os protótipos.


RESULTADOS ESPERADOS:

  • Relatório de Avaliação de Conformidade (por linha de produto).
  • Resumo e recomendações da Validação Matemática.
  • Documento com Diretrizes de Localização.
  • Pacote de documentação técnica pronto para submissão ao laboratório de certificação.
  • Apresentação final resumindo os principais riscos, melhorias e próximos passos.


REQUITOS NECESSÁRIOS:

  • Experiência comprovada em conformidade, certificação e validação matemática (RTP, RNG e volatilidade) de jogos.
  • Familiaridade com a regulamentação brasileira de iGaming e processos de certificação de laboratórios.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de documentação.
  • Experiência em trabalho multifuncional com estúdios, engenheiros e equipes de conformidade.
  • Inglês Avançado (necessário para lidar com Stakeholders global)


O QUE VOCÊ VAI ENCONTRAR AQUI:

  • Contrato PJ com remuneração compatível com o mercado de iGaming;
  • Ambiente global e inovador do mercado de Igaming;

title: Sr. / Lead QA Automation Engineer (Angular • Golang • AWS/GCP • Full-Stack Automation)
description:
Role: Senior/Lead QA Automation Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Long Term

Work Hours: PST

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Location: 100% Remote


We are seeking a Senior/Lead QA Automation Engineer to assess the current QA landscape and build a test automation strategy and framework from scratch . This role is fully hands-on, covering Frontend (Angular), Backend (Golang), APIs, and Databases, while driving automation, CI/CD integration, and quality best practices across the engineering organization.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute test plans, regression suites, and full-stack validation (UI, API, backend).
  • Build and maintain automation frameworks using Cypress/Playwright/Selenium, and backend/API tools (Pytest, REST Assured, Postman).
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab, CircleCI, Azure DevOps).
  • Test Angular frontend apps and Golang backend/microservices, including data flows and distributed system behavior.
  • Validate SQL/NoSQL databases and data integrity.
  • Debug issues with developers and ensure testability in design discussions.
  • Perform performance/load testing using JMeter, K6, Locust, or Gatling.
  • Monitor logs/metrics with Datadog, Grafana, ELK, CloudWatch, or GCP Stackdriver.
  • Document test strategies and lead quality reviews throughout the SDLC.


Required Qualifications

  • 3–7+ years in QA Automation or SDET roles.
  • Strong full-stack QA experience: Angular, Golang, APIs, microservices, Databases.
  • Hands-on automation across UI, API, and backend services.
  • Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, or Go.
  • Experience with distributed systems, CI/CD pipelines, and debugging complex issues.
  • Cloud experience with AWS or GCP required.

title: Backend Developer  - Pleno
description:
Backend Developer - Pleno


Collaborate with data scientists and ML engineers to understand requirements for ML/LLM features. Design, implement, maintain, improve, and document backend systems (Python, FastAPI) for ML/LLM features. Manage and optimize databases (Postgres, MongoDB, Milvus) for application storage. Improve observability and reliability for distributed, async workloads (structured logging, metrics, retry/backoff strategies, traces). Help maintain and orchestrate containerized development workflows (uv, Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes) and CI checks. Raise the bar for testing (unit + integration) to ensure high code quality and reliability. Improve the local development experience for the team by establishing and promoting Python-based development standards and best practices. Integrate and optimize calls to LLM APIs (OpenAI) and agentic frameworks (OpenAI Agents SDK). Mentor other engineers and drive architectural decisions.


Requirements


  • Experience in backend engineering, specifically in building production services, with over 2 years of expertise in working with asynchronous Python.
  • Extensive Python knowledge: async/await, typing system, modern Pydantic (v2), and testing frameworks (pytest).
  • Production experience building RESTful APIs with FastAPI and ASGI servers (uvicorn).
  • Solid operational and debugging skills for async systems and distributed services.
  • Strong familiarity with Postgres and MongoDB databases.
  • Experience with vector search systems (Milvus, FAISS, Pinecone) and embedding pipelines.
  • Experience with message queues, background processing, and patterns for batch processing, idempotency, and retries.
  • Practical experience integrating with OpenAI or other LLM providers.
  • Comfortable working with containerization technologies (Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with AWS services (EKS, ECS, S3).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions).
  • Good communication skills and ability to work effectively in a remote team environment.
  • Good English proficiency (reading, writing, speaking).

title: SR Analista de Banco de Dados (SQL)
description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.


Certificada pelo 5º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!


#Vempraília


Responsabilidades

  • Realizar análise, modelagem, administração e otimização de bancos de dados SQL;
  • Desenvolver e manter consultas, procedures, triggers e views otimizadas;
  • Apoiar o time de desenvolvimento em integrações e boas práticas de acesso a dados;
  • Identificar gargalos de performance e propor soluções para melhoria contínua;
  • Atuar em conjunto com equipes de desenvolvimento .NET na análise e evolução de sistemas;
  • Garantir a segurança, disponibilidade e integridade dos dados corporativos;
  • Documentar processos e propor melhorias em estruturas e rotinas de banco de dados.


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida em SQL Server (T-SQL) — análise, modelagem e performance tuning;
  • Vivência com rotinas de backup, restore e manutenção de banco de dados;
  • Experiência com ambientes de desenvolvimento .NET (C#, Entity Framework, integração com bancos de dados);
  • Conhecimento em análise de queries e otimização de performance;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de versionamento (Git, Bitbucket, etc.);
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa com times multidisciplinares.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados em nuvem (Azure SQL, AWS RDS);
  • Experiência com automação de scripts e CI/CD;
  • Vivência com monitoramento de bancos de dados e análise de logs.


Benefícios e Incentivos:

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília


Para Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Caju benefícios
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;
  • TotalPass.


Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;


Gostamos de ir além no cuidado com as nossas pessoas, então dispomos também de alguns benefícios não convencionais:

  • Plano de Saúde PET - Guapeco
  • Onhappy – benefício de viagem a lazer, com liberdade para você viajar com quem quiser.
  • BYOD - Alugamos o seu notebook pessoal te pagando um valor mensal para que você o use, mas disponibilizamos também máquinas de trabalho para ílians. Você quem decide!
  • Seu Niver, seu bolo!
  • Seu Networking Vale Prêmio - Programa de premiação a indicação de novos funcionários.

Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.


Certificada pelo 5º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!


#Vempraília


Responsabilidades

  • Realizar análise, modelagem, administração e otimização de bancos de dados SQL;

title: Junior Java Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Java Developer to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, and get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Work with software development teams to gather requirements and ensure best practices are adhered.

- Design, Implement & Support solutions for application development, security, analytics, and performance management.

- Conform to existing industry security coding standards adhering to fortify scan and other security tool review requirements.

- Conduct code reviews for junior members of the team and do peer code reviews to make sure the code is following standards set forward by the architects.

- Run test scripts against code to ensure quality delivery.

- Resolve code issues with urgency.


Requirements:


- 1+ years of experience in Java.

- Experience in web application programming.

- Knowledge of Object Oriented Programming.

- Ability to work with relational and non-relational bases.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Meta Media Buyer
description:
We are looking to add another member to our growing team at TopGrowthMarketing.com. This position is for Social/Facebook campaign managers who will be working remotely.

This individual would have experience running Facebook and Instagram paid ads, and have great verbal communication to engage with both the team and clients. Salary will be commensurate with experience.

  • 2+ years of PAID Facebook ADVERTISING experience. (Blueprint Certified Preferred)
  • 2+ years of experience managing clients/accounts. (Any industry)
  • Knowledge of Google Analytics.
  • Strong, professional verbal communication.
  • Excellent writing and creative content skills.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
  • Exceptional time management skills, including the ability to handle multiple projects and ongoing work items; while effectively managing changing priorities.
  • Innovative thinker and collaborative team player.
  • Understanding pixel and tracking set up

This position is for an individual looking to join our team full-time. Please do not submit any agency or white label applications.

The responsibilities of this position include but are not limited to:

  • Manage social ad accounts
  • Be proactive about finding new strategies and tactics to help clients achieve their goals.
  • Manage communication with client (emails, calls etc)
  • Deliver insights to copy and creative team to improve ads
  • Continuously measure and optimize campaign performance while also establishing benchmarks and recommending future tests.
  • Develop marketing strategies and marketing plans to support and achieve the client’s business objectives.
  • Prepare reports and present results to clients and management.


This position pays hourly. Fully remote. 2 bonuses per year!

title: Analista de suporte de TI - Pleno
description:
Damos as boas-vindas ao universo de experiências Ingresse ! ️


Somos uma empresa global de entretenimento e líder na América Latina, fornecendo tecnologia, soluções e insights para o setor de eventos.


Acreditamos que o verdadeiro valor da vida está nas experiências que vivemos e nas histórias que compartilhamos. Usamos nosso conhecimento em curadoria e tecnologia para trazer não apenas eventos que estão transformando a indústria e a vida das pessoas, mas também inovações para quebrar a mesmice.


Estamos buscando um(a) Analista de Suporte de T.I. pleno, para somar com o nosso time Tech!


Missão do cargo:

Garantir a continuidade dos serviços de TI atuando no suporte de 2º nível, resolvendo chamados que não podem ser solucionados pelo SAC. A missão é oferecer atendimento técnico ágil e preciso, apoiando usuários internos e externos e integrando diferentes áreas, sempre com foco em troubleshooting, automação e confiabilidade.


Responsabilidades:

● Atender e resolver chamados escalados pelo SAC, atuando com foco em análise de causa raiz;

● Executar consultas e ajustes básicos em banco de dados para resolução de problemas;

● Criar e manter scripts de automação para otimizar atividades repetitivas;

● Monitorar sistemas críticos com ferramentas como Datadog e Grafana, atuando proativamente em incidentes;

● Colaborar com outras áreas técnicas, garantindo boa comunicação e registro das soluções aplicadas.


Requisitos:

● Conhecimentos básicos em SQL e bancos de dados relacionais;

● Experiência com automação e scripts (Shell, Python ou similar);

● Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento (Datadog, Grafana ou equivalentes);

● Boa comunicação e habilidade de troubleshooting.


Diferenciais:

● Conhecimento em ambientes de NOC (Network Operations Center);

● Experiência prévia com suporte técnico de 1º ou 2º nível;

● Noções de boas práticas de segurança da informação;

● Conhecimento em AWS.


Benefícios:

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Auxílio Home Office;
  • Gympass/Wellhub;
  • Custeio de plano de saúde baseado em um plano da SulAmérica.
  • Vale transporte;
  • Day off de aniversário;
  • ZenKlub (saúde mental);
  • Bônus Anual;


Assim como todas as nossas vagas, esta também é voltada para a diversidade e inclusão. Independentemente de qualquer fator, perfil ou característica, venha ampliar sua carreira na Ingresse.


Para conhecer mais sobre a nossa missão, visão e valores, acesse o Sobre Nós:

Acreditamos que o verdadeiro valor da vida está nas experiências que vivemos e nas histórias que compartilhamos. Usamos nosso conhecimento em curadoria e tecnologia para trazer não apenas eventos que estão transformando a indústria e a vida das pessoas, mas também inovações para quebrar a mesmice.


Estamos buscando um(a) Analista de Suporte de T.I. pleno, para somar com o nosso time Tech!


Missão do cargo:

Garantir a continuidade dos serviços de TI atuando no suporte de 2º nível, resolvendo chamados que não podem ser solucionados pelo SAC. A missão é oferecer atendimento técnico ágil e preciso, apoiando usuários internos e externos e integrando diferentes áreas, sempre com foco em troubleshooting, automação e confiabilidade.


Responsabilidades:

● Atender e resolver chamados escalados pelo SAC, atuando com foco em análise de causa raiz;

● Executar consultas e ajustes básicos em banco de dados para resolução de problemas;

● Criar e manter scripts de automação para otimizar atividades repetitivas;

● Monitorar sistemas críticos com ferramentas como Datadog e Grafana, atuando proativamente em incidentes;

● Colaborar com outras áreas técnicas, garantindo boa comunicação e registro das soluções aplicadas.


Requisitos:

● Conhecimentos básicos em SQL e bancos de dados relacionais;

● Experiência com automação e scripts (Shell, Python ou similar);

● Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento (Datadog, Grafana ou equivalentes);

● Boa comunicação e habilidade de troubleshooting.


Diferenciais:

● Conhecimento em ambientes de NOC (Network Operations Center);

● Experiência prévia com suporte técnico de 1º ou 2º nível;

● Noções de boas práticas de segurança da informação;

● Conhecimento em AWS.


Benefícios:

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Auxílio Home Office;
  • Gympass/Wellhub;
  • Custeio de plano de saúde baseado em um plano da SulAmérica.
  • Vale transporte;
  • Day off de aniversário;
  • ZenKlub (saúde mental);
  • Bônus Anual;


Assim como todas as nossas vagas, esta também é voltada para a diversidade e inclusão. Independentemente de qualquer fator, perfil ou característica, venha ampliar sua carreira na Ingresse.

title: Analista de Projetos e Sistemas de TI Sênior
description:
Sobre a vaga


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.

Estamos com uma oportunidade para o nosso time corporativo para: Analista de Projetos e Sistemas de TI Sênior


Responsabilidades:

  • Interação entre Negócio e Tecnologia: Levantar e detalhar requisitos funcionais e técnicos, traduzir necessidades do negócio em especificações claras, apoiar PM na validação de escopo e priorização de backlog.
  • Apoio Técnico ao Time: Ajudar TM e TL na compreensão das regras de negócio e integrações, acompanhar evolução do produto e organizar documentação funcional e técnica.
  • Processos e Entregas: Participar das cerimônias ágeis, apoiar na construção de fluxos e diagramas, realizar homologação funcional e apoiar testes end-to-end.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência como Analista de Sistemas ou Negócios em times ágeis.
  • Sólido conhecimento em levantamento e detalhamento de requisitos.
  • Vivência em produtos bancários ou meios de pagamento (preferencialmente PIX).
  • Compreensão técnica de aplicações em .NET , Angular , Ionic e Elixir (diferencial).
  • Familiaridade com APIs, integrações, microsserviços e boas práticas de arquitetura.
  • Boa comunicação com times técnicos e de negócio.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em SQUADs de pagamentos instantâneos ou banking digital.
  • Conhecimento do ecossistema BACEN, SPI, DICT, QR Code dinâmico/estático.
  • Experiência com ferramentas como Jira, Confluence, Swagger e Postman.
  • Conhecimento em práticas DevOps, observabilidade e logs.

Soft Skills Importantes:

  • Boa comunicação, perfil colaborativo, organização e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Proatividade e capacidade de simplificar temas complexos.


Modelo de trabalho:


  • Remoto: Home office - 100%.


PJ - 30 dias de descanso remunerado


Todas as nossas oportunidades de trabalho estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack (Python/React) Senior
description:
Na Jaya Tech, acreditamos na Engenharia de Software Consciente, uma abordagem inovadora, e por isso oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho inspirador, focado em promover o autoconhecimento, tomar decisões embasadas em dados, cultivar relacionamentos saudáveis e entender o impacto do nosso trabalho. Aqui, você encontrará oportunidades para crescimento profissional e pessoal, contribuindo para projetos que têm um impacto significativo na indústria e na sociedade.


Sobre o Projeto

Você fará parte de um time de uma empresa do segmento que desenvolve tecnologia para o setor de seguros.


Atuação 100% remota | Ingles Fluente | Forma de contratação: Contractor | Reuneração: Dólar | Full-time


Requisitos Necessários

Senioridade em desenvolvimento Fullstack

Product thinking — importante discutir soluções e não apenas executar tarefas

Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma e contribuir com desenho arquitetural

Comunicação confortável em inglês

Experiência sólida com JavaScript + TypeScript

Domínio de React (principal linguagem no frontend)

Experiência em gerenciamento de chamadas a REST APIs

Conhecimento em testes unitários e de UI no frontend

Ferramentas de frontend: Eslint, Prettier, bundle optimization, Sonarcloud

Experiência sólida em Python (principal linguagem backend)

Vivência em AWS Cloud (Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, Kubernetes, Kafka/Queues)

Experiência em sistemas distribuídos, microsserviços e arquitetura orientada a eventos


Requisitos Desejáveis

Experiência com React Native

Vivência com soluções de data/state management diferentes de Redux e Context API

Experiência com Java como linguagem complementar


Responsabilidades

Atuar no desenvolvimento fullstack, contribuindo tanto no frontend (React/TypeScript) quanto no backend (Python/AWS)

Participar ativamente da discussão de soluções, aplicando product thinking e propondo alternativas técnicas viáveis

Contribuir para o desenho da arquitetura do novo produto, incluindo microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos

Desenvolver e manter aplicações frontend com foco em qualidade, performance e testabilidade

Criar e dar manutenção em serviços backend em Python, com uso de AWS Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, K8s e Kafka/Queues

Garantir a qualidade do código e das entregas, assumindo responsabilidade pelos testes automatizados (unitários, UI e integração)

Trabalhar de forma autônoma, colaborando com o time na definição de padrões e boas práticas

Otimizar e monitorar aplicações, aplicando práticas de event-driven architecture e escalabilidade em nuvem

Colaborar em um ambiente ágil, mantendo comunicação clara em inglês com o time e stakeholders

title: Process Optimization Partner
description:
About the Role


The Process Optimization Partner plays a key role in transforming the People Team’s operations through technology, automation, and intelligent systems. You’ll analyse workflows, identify inefficiencies, and design scalable solutions that enhance the employee and stakeholder experience. This role blends strategic problem-solving with hands-on implementation, leveraging AI tools, process automation, chatbot systems, and dynamic knowledge bases to optimize how the People Team operates.


Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate, document, and improve People Team workflows across the employee lifecycle (recruiting, onboarding, development, engagement, and offboarding).
  • Identify automation opportunities using tools like Zapier, Workato, Power Automate, or internal HRIS systems.
  • Partner with HR stakeholders to reduce manual work, streamline approvals, and improve process accuracy.
